items.headline: RBI Likely to Hike Interest Rates Amidst Persistent Inflationary Pressures
items.summary: Retail inflation exceeded 6% in October 2026 and is anticipated to remain elevated in November due to continued pressure on food prices, increasing the likelihood of another interest rate hike by the RBI in its December policy review.

items.headline: Government Approves Capital Expenditure for Critical Minerals and Urea Plants
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved ₹2,814 crore for domestic processing of lithium and nickel to reduce import dependence, and sanctioned six new brownfield urea plants to boost domestic production.

items.headline: RBI Urges Banks to Strengthen Cybersecurity and API Ownership
items.summary: The RBI has directed banks to enhance monitoring of peripheral systems around core banking platforms and take full ownership of their APIs to combat rising cyberattacks and fraud.

items.headline: Indian Markets Face Mixed Global Cues; Brent Crude at Monthly Highs
items.summary: Indian benchmark indices are expected to open lower or flat due to mixed global market signals, with Brent crude prices hovering near monthly highs driven by increased attacks in West Asia.

items.headline: Asian Markets Show Modest Gains with Recovery in AI Stocks
items.summary: Asian markets observed a modest positive trend in early trading, partly due to a recovery in artificial intelligence (AI)-related stocks, although profit-taking limited overall gains.

items.headline: Corporate India Reports Strong Q2 FY27 Earnings with Robust Profit and Revenue Growth
items.summary: Corporate India delivered a strong performance in the July-September 2026 quarter, with aggregate net profit for 3,568 listed companies rising by 26.2% year-on-year, and aggregate revenue growing by 22.6%.

items.headline: ICRA Projects Healthy Q3 FY27 Revenue Growth Despite Margin Compression
items.summary: ICRA forecasts healthy year-on-year revenue growth of 18-20% for its sample set of 3,103 listed companies in Q3 FY27, though inflationary pressures are likely to compress operating profit margins by 50-75 basis points.

items.headline: Nifty Metal and Chemical Indices Witness Gains, Lenders and Hotels Show Strong Performance
items.summary: On November 27, Nifty Metal and Nifty Chemical indices saw gains. Jefferies noted a rare trend of earnings upgrades for lenders and hotel companies, indicating strong sectoral performance.

items.headline: IT, Realty Lead Gains While Consumer Durables, FMCG, Auto, PSU Banks Face Pressure
items.summary: On November 26, the IT and Realty sectors led gains in the market, while Consumer Durables, FMCG, Auto, and PSU Banks experienced pressure, showing mixed sectoral performance.

items.headline: NSE Receives RBI Approval for Corporate Bond Index Futures
items.summary: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) has secured approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to launch futures contracts linked to corporate bond indices.

items.headline: Tata Motors Increases Stake in Automobile Corporation of Goa, Making it a Subsidiary
items.summary: Tata Motors' stake in Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited (ACGL) rose to 50.17% following a share buyback, resulting in ACGL becoming a subsidiary.

items.headline: Zydus Lifesciences Receives USFDA Complete Response Letter for Saroglitazar NDA
items.summary: Zydus Lifesciences' US subsidiary received a Complete Response Letter (CRL) from the USFDA for its New Drug Application (NDA) for Saroglitazar, linked to observations from an inspection of its Moraiya facility.

items.headline: KPI Green Energy Commissions Additional 65.1 MWp Capacity
items.summary: KPI Green Energy has commissioned an additional 65.1 MWp capacity as part of its hybrid independent power producer (IPP) project in Gujarat.

items.headline: Zydus Lifesciences, NSE, and BSE in Focus Following Recent Developments
items.summary: Zydus Lifesciences is in focus after its USFDA Complete Response Letter, while NSE and BSE are watched following RBI approval for corporate bond index futures.

items.headline: Titan Sees Gains While IT, Auto, and Banking Majors Lag
items.summary: On Friday, Titan was a top gainer, while major IT companies (HCL Tech, TCS, Infosys, Tech Mahindra), auto (Maruti), and banking stocks (Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank) were among the laggards.
